analysis_method: Manual pattern extraction from BattleGroup source documents
sources_analyzed: Battlegroup-Kursk.txt - German Panzer Division army lists
Sample size: 40+ units with points and BR values
data_quality: High confidence - extracted from official published army lists

infantry_teams_small.description: 2-3 man teams with no heavy weapons

infantry_teams_support_weapons.description: 2-3 man teams with support weapons (mortars, MGs, AT rifles)
infantry_teams_support_weapons.pattern: Heavier weapon = higher points and BR

infantry_squads.pattern: Transport (halftrack) adds ~15-20 pts, +1 BR. Elite adds ~12 pts, +1 BR

infantry_platoons.pattern: Platoon BR ≈ sum of component BRs

light_tanks.description: Panzer II, early Panzer III variants

medium_tanks.pattern: Better gun (L43 vs L48) adds ~6-12 pts. Better armor (G->H) adds similar amount

command_units.pattern: Senior officers have higher BR (importance to force morale)

infantry_teams.rule: Small support teams: 0-1 BR. Weapon teams: 1-2 BR

infantry_squads.rule: Basic squads: 2 BR. Veteran/elite or specialized: 3 BR

tanks.rule: Most tanks: 3 BR regardless of type. Some exceptions for unique/restricted units

support_weapons.rule: Light weapons (MG, light mortar): 1 BR. Heavy weapons (AT gun, medium mortar): 2 BR

command_units.rule: Junior officers: 1 BR. Senior officers: 3 BR. Indicates importance to force morale

elite.effect: Highest points cost (+30-50%). Often adds +1 BR

examples.name: Panzer Grenadier Platoon upgrade to Elite

components.name: gun_effectiveness
components.note: AP penetration + HE dice major factor

components.name: weapons
components.note: Support weapons (MG, mortar, AT) major factor

armor_vs_points.evidence: Panzer III (armor K-N): 30-40 pts. Panzer IV (armor L-K): 44-56 pts. Panther (armor H-K): ~73 pts
armor_vs_points.interpretation: Better armor significantly increases points cost

gun_vs_points.evidence: Panzer IV F1 (75mm L24): 44 pts. Panzer IV G (75mm L43): 50 pts. Panzer IV H (75mm L48): 56 pts
gun_vs_points.interpretation: Better gun (longer barrel, higher penetration) adds ~6-12 pts

experience_vs_points.evidence: Regular squad: 26 pts. Veteran squad: ~30-35 pts. Elite upgrade: +12 pts per squad
experience_vs_points.interpretation: Higher experience adds 15-50% to base cost

br_vs_unit_importance.evidence: Tanks always 3 BR (key assets). Senior officers 3 BR. Support teams 0-2 BR (expendable)
br_vs_unit_importance.interpretation: BR reflects unit's importance to force morale, not combat power

points_calculator: Points reflect combat effectiveness (armor + firepower + mobility)
Formula likely: BASE_COST + (armor_factor * weight) + (gun_factor * weight) + (mobility_factor * weight)
Experience multiplier: Regular x1.0, Veteran x1.2, Elite x1.5, Inexperienced x0.7
Transport adds fixed cost: Halftrack ~15-20 pts, Truck ~4 pts
Special rules add/subtract: Unreliable -10%, Radio +5%, etc.
br_assigner: BR reflects unit importance to force morale, NOT combat power
Most tanks: 3 BR (regardless of type - even light tanks)
Experience affects BR in platoons (+1 BR per experience tier for multi-unit formations)
validation_targets: Points calculator: aim for ±10% of observed values
BR assigner: aim for 90%+ exact match (discrete values 0-5)
Test against diverse unit types (infantry, tanks, guns, vehicles)
Validate across nations (German, Russian, British, American patterns may vary slightly)

approach: Start with vehicle type base costs (light/medium/heavy)
Add armor factor (convert letter rating to numeric scale, multiply by coefficient)
Add gun factor (AP penetration average, multiply by coefficient)
Add mobility factor (movement speed, multiply by coefficient)
Test on 20 sample vehicles, tune coefficients to match observed values
next_steps_for_chunk_2.validation: Compare calculated points to observed values, aim for ±10% accuracy
